if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[ROUTINES] where SPECIFIC_SCHEMA = 'integration' and SPECIFIC_NAME = 'GetObjectByAssetTypeId') begin IF EXISTS (SELECT f.name FROM sys.Computed_columns f inner join sys.objects o on f.object_id = o.object_id where SCHEMA_NAME(schema_id) = 'integration' and o.name = 'SynchedAssetType' and F.name ='Object' and f.is_computed = 1 ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [integration].[SynchedAssetType] DROP column [Object] END
drop function [integration].[GetObjectByAssetTypeId]; end
